CzymJestVesicaKarma.podtytul: A universal matrix of destiny — Astrology, Numerology and Palmistry in one sacred geometry.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.trzyWarunki: A human being isn't the sum of coincidences, but a precisely designed weave of time, place and body. Each of us, to come into this world, had to fulfill these three conditions — and each one has its counterpart in a different ancient Vedic system of reading:
CzymJestVesicaKarma.astrologiaPunkt: Vedic astrology (time and place) — the arrangement of planets and cosmic forces at the exact moment of your birth.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.numerologiaPunkt: Numerology (the vibration of time and name) — the cyclical rhythm of your life and the potential encoded in your name.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.hiromancjaPunkt: Palmistry (the record in the body) — a cosmic archetype translated directly onto the lines of your hands. Our karma is written in the body just as it is in the stars — it only needs to be found and put to use.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.zadenNieIstnieje: None of these systems exists in isolation. Three overlapping circles form the living matrix of your life — each describes the same pattern from a different perspective:
CzymJestVesicaKarma.wykresAlt: Diagram: Birth branches into Time, Place and Body — these correspond to Numerology, Astrology and Palmistry, which together lead to the Wheel of Karma (Mahadashas/Yogas/Doshas, Astrocartography), answering the questions When? Where? What next?
CzymJestVesicaKarma.dlonDominujaca: In palmistry: your dominant hand is like the D1 (Rasi) birth chart — the active hand is the world of physical manifestation and the here-and-now: daily choices, visible actions, the way you carry out your fate in the material world.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.dlonBierna: Your non-dominant hand is like the D9 (Navamsa) chart — the passive hand is the spiritual foundation and karmic record: innate predispositions, hidden potential, the spiritual inheritance you're born with.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.kiedyGdzieCoDalej: Your Wheel of Karma: when, where, and what next
CzymJestVesicaKarma.wPunkcieNakladania: At the point where these three spheres overlap, the Wheel of Karma emerges — a complete synthesis. The app doesn't just uncover your karmic record, it gives you concrete navigational tools:
CzymJestVesicaKarma.kiedyDzialac: When to act? Mahadashas, yogas and doshas point to the right time for decisions and change.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.gdzieRozwijac: Where to spread your wings? Astrocartography shows places on Earth that favor your potential, relationships and career.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.coZTymZrobic: What to do with it? Practical guidance on turning knowledge of your karmic structure into everyday choices.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.vesicaPiscisCzymJest: What exactly is a Vesica Piscis? It's one of the oldest symbols in sacred geometry: two circles of exactly the same radius, positioned so that the center of each one lies on the other's circumference. Where they overlap, they form an almond shape known as the "vessel of the fish" (Latin vesica piscis) — since antiquity, a symbol of two separate wholes meeting and merging into one new quality.
CzymJestVesicaKarma.vesicaPiscis: Our system takes this one step further — instead of two, three circles overlap: Astrology, Numerology and Palmistry. Each pair forms its own Vesica Piscis (Where, When, Who), and the point where all three overlap at once is the Wheel of Karma. It symbolizes the coherence of three overlapping spheres: body, mind and soul; past, present and future. It's not a rigid sentence, but a living space where cosmic design, personal rhythm and body meet, giving you full control over your own path.

Each date is compared with the other days of your life — so you can see whether it is a real hit or chance.

DziedzinyTalentu.eyebrow: Music, art, words… — talent from a combination of planets, houses and yogas
DziedzinyTalentu.wstep: The Predispositions above show the strength of each planet separately. But a talent such as music or writing does not belong to a single planet — it arises from a combination of several planets, houses and yogas. Here each area gathers its classical indicators and shows them on the same axis.
DziedzinyTalentu.jakCzytac: To the right: potential (indicators that support the area), to the left: friction (those that hold it back). The numbers next to the bars are percentiles on a common scale (20,000 charts). The result is the Balance — the difference in points — shown next to the average balance of the same area in other people and the share of people whose balance is lower. Click an area to see which planets, houses and yogas it is made of.
DziedzinyTalentu.podpowiedz: Potential: {potencjal}th percentile (+{plus} pts) · Friction: {tarcie}th percentile (−{minus} pts) · Balance {bilans} pts — {opis} (stronger than {bilansPct}% of areas in the sample)
DziedzinyTalentu.podpowiedzSrednia: · The average balance of “{planeta}” in others: {srednia} pts — yours is higher than {procent}% of people.
DziedzinyTalentu.syntezaWspieraja: Compared with other people, your strongest areas are: {lista}.
DziedzinyTalentu.syntezaBrakWsparcia: No area stands clearly above average — your talents are spread fairly evenly and will grow where you put in the work.
DziedzinyTalentu.syntezaBrakTarcia: No area falls clearly below average — nothing in the chart closes a path for you.
DziedzinyTalentu.brakGodziny: Talent areas are calculated from the houses, which require the time of birth.
DziedzinyTalentu.uwaga: These are indications of the chart, not a verdict — a talent still has to be developed, and a low balance does not close the path to an area, it only means less will come by itself.

opisy.sun: You may more easily than others slip into the role of the one who has to be right and be noticed. It's worth watching that the need for recognition doesn't replace listening to others.
opisy.moon: Mood and emotions can take the wheel faster than you notice. It's worth building routines that stabilize you before a wave of emotion decides for you.
opisy.mars: It's easy to react faster than you think — especially under pressure. It's worth consciously giving yourself a moment before responding to frustration with action.
opisy.mercury: The mind can jump between threads faster than you can wrap them up. It's worth watching that the amount of words doesn't replace the quality of what's said.
opisy.jupiter: Optimism and the urge to advise can obscure the fact that the other person never asked for advice. It's worth asking sometimes before lecturing.
opisy.venus: It's easy to choose comfort and a nice mood over a difficult but necessary conversation. Harmony shouldn't mean avoiding a conflict that needs to be worked through.
opisy.saturn: Self-criticism can be harsher than criticism of anyone else. Worth remembering that discipline without rest eventually takes its toll.
opisy.rahu: The desire for "more" rarely ends in a feeling of "enough". It's worth consciously naming the moment when things are already good.
opisy.ketu: It's easy to withdraw from a topic before it's truly resolved. The intuitive "it doesn't matter anymore" can be an escape from something important.

OsDomeny.jakCzytac: To the right: potential (the sum of supporting factors); to the left: friction (the sum of hindering ones). The numbers by the bars are percentiles on the same scale for everyone (20,000 charts) — 80 means stronger than in 8 out of 10 people. These two numbers aren't subtracted from each other because they sit on different scales. The result is shown by the Balance: the difference in points (support minus friction). To show whether it's a lot or a little, next to it is the average balance of the same planet in other people and the share of people whose balance is lower — planets have different natural levels (an average Jupiter is about +3.0, an average Rahu about −0.6). Click a row to see all factors with their weight.

OsPredyspozycji.wstep: Each of the nine <graha>grahas</graha> has factors in your chart that support it and factors that hold it back — the same planet can be both a strength and a source of friction. Ordered from the greatest advantage of support.

Talenty.wstep: <jogiklasyczne>Yogas</jogiklasyczne> are classical, named combinations of several planets at once, considered indicators of innate talent and luck — a different language than Predispositions above (those score each planet's strength separately). Yogas are rarer and more special: most charts have zero or one or two, not nine like in the planet ranking. Their absence doesn't mean an absence of talent — just an absence of THIS specific, named combination.
Talenty.brak: None of the classical, named yogas appear in your chart in pure form — that's normal and applies to most charts. Your strengths are still clearly visible in Predispositions above, which don't depend on whether one of these specific combinations happens to occur.

WrazliwoscDuchowa.wstep: Classical Jyotish doesn't have a separate category for specific "paranormal abilities" (e.g. dowsing) — this is a different, more honest theme: a natural sensitivity to the immaterial (intuition, atmosphere, the subconscious), arising from Ketu (the classical karaka of intuition and mysticism) and the 8th house (mystery), 9th house (dharma, guru, faith) and 12th house (spirituality). This is a theme and tendency visible in the chart — not a verified "power" or a guarantee of a specific ability.
WrazliwoscDuchowa.przechylaSie: In your chart this theme tilts most toward:
WrazliwoscDuchowa.skadWynika: Where this comes from in your chart:
WrazliwoscDuchowa.brakCzynnikow: None of the five checked factors (Ketu's condition, planets in the 8th/9th/12th house, Moon-Ketu conjunction, Jupiter's aspect on Ketu) appeared in your chart in a distinct form.

opisy.wyraźna: A distinct theme in your chart — sensing the unspoken comes more easily to you than to many others: moods, the atmosphere of places, subtle signals others miss.
opisy.umiarkowana: Present, but not a dominant theme — you have access to this sensitivity, though it doesn't define your whole nature the way it does for people with a stronger indication.
opisy.subtelna: Faint, in the background — this side isn't especially sharpened in you. That's not a shortcoming, other themes in your chart simply speak louder.

ZawodKariera.eyebrow: Which planets speak about your work — and how easily each direction will come
ZawodKariera.wstep: Only planets that are genuinely connected to the 10th house in your chart — the house of action in the world — are shown here: they stand in it, rule it (counted from the lagna, the Moon and the Sun), are pointed to by Varahamihira's classical rule, stand together with the 10th lord (especially when it is combust), are the yogakaraka or the Amatyakaraka, or play a role in the dashamsha (D10). The order is set by the strength of this connection, not by the planet's strength alone — so no planet dominates for everyone.
ZawodKariera.jakCzytac: To the right: potential — the connection to career and what strengthens the planet; to the left: friction — what weakens it, i.e. where this direction will need more work. The numbers next to the bars are percentiles on a common scale (20,000 charts). The balance is compared with the same planet in other people for whom it is also connected to career. Click a planet to see all connections with their weights and possible career directions.
ZawodKariera.podpowiedz: Potential: {potencjal}th percentile (+{plus} pts) · Friction: {tarcie}th percentile (−{minus} pts) · Balance {bilans} pts — {opis} (stronger than {bilansPct}% of indications in the sample)

ZawodKariera.syntezaBrakTarcia: No career planet has a clear advantage of friction — nothing in the chart blocks your professional path.
ZawodKariera.brakGodziny: Profession and career are calculated from the 10th house, which requires the time of birth.
ZawodKariera.uwaga: These are directions, not a list of the only possible professions — they work best where several planets at the top of the list point to a similar area.

opisy.sun: a career built through visibility, authority and taking responsibility — leadership, administration, politics, medicine. You naturally do better where you are recognised, not in the shadows.
opisy.moon: work goes well where contact with people and fluid adaptation to change matter — care, catering, hospitality, nursing. Emotional stability translates directly into professional stability.
opisy.mars: a career that takes off through courage and fast, decisive action — engineering, sport, rescue, surgery, the services. Best where the effect of action is visible at once, not in slow-ticking bureaucracy.
opisy.mercury: work with words and numbers comes naturally — trade, writing, journalism, accounting, IT. A profession where every day you analyse, negotiate or explain something to others.
opisy.jupiter: a career based on knowledge and moral authority — teaching, law, consulting, finance, spirituality. You naturally inspire trust as someone who sees further than the current project.
opisy.venus: work with aesthetics and relationships — art, fashion, beauty, music, diplomacy. A profession where good taste and the ability to ease tension between people matter.
opisy.saturn: a career built over years, systematically, without shortcuts — construction, administration, agriculture, work requiring discipline. What you build lasts longer than for others, but starts more slowly.
opisy.rahu: the career path tends to be unusual and modern — technology, foreign business, media. Fast, unexpected success is possible where others do not yet see the opportunity.
opisy.ketu: behind-the-scenes work without publicity — research, technical support, healing. A profession where the result matters more than who gets the applause.

uwagaTematy.mars: impulsive career decisions, conflicts with authority
uwagaTematy.mercury: scattering across too many career paths at once
uwagaTematy.jupiter: theorising instead of concrete professional action
uwagaTematy.venus: choosing comfort at the cost of real career growth
uwagaTematy.saturn: excessive perfectionism, too slow a pace of promotion
uwagaTematy.ketu: lack of professional ambition, handing initiative to others

uwagaOpisy.sun: It is easy to defend your own position as a matter of honour instead of accepting criticism or fitting into a structure. Remember that authority is also built by listening to others.
uwagaOpisy.moon: Mood can decide your engagement at work more than a plan or strategy. It helps to build work routines that do not depend on how you feel at the moment.
uwagaOpisy.mars: The urge to act quickly can be stronger than thinking through the consequences of a career decision. Give yourself a moment before responding impulsively to a boss or a client.
uwagaOpisy.mercury: It is easy to spread yourself across several career paths at once instead of finishing one properly. Make sure the number of open projects does not replace their quality.
uwagaOpisy.jupiter: A broad view of your career can dominate so much that concrete, practical steps take a back seat. Sometimes it is better to simply finish one task instead of planning ten more.
uwagaOpisy.venus: Comfort and the aesthetics of the workplace can obscure what really develops a career in the long run. Do not avoid tasks that do not look impressive but matter.
uwagaOpisy.saturn: Striving for perfect execution can slow a career so much that opportunities pass by. Remember that “good enough and on time” also builds a reputation.
uwagaOpisy.rahu: You are drawn to the newest, most exciting career paths, and proven ones get abandoned without a real reason. Check twice before trusting something new.
uwagaOpisy.ketu: It is easy to lose interest in your career once the initial fascination fades and to leave the initiative to others. Consciously return to professional matters that are easy to let go.
